note: Greenfield project: no source files exist yet, so content_sha256 is null for every contract. forge-run Phase C.5 should treat null as 'not yet materialized' and verify symbol existence only after the owning sub-spec has run.

contracts.name: Placement
contracts.signature: Placement(scale_x: float, scale_y: float, tx: float, ty: float, rotate_deg: int) — frozen dataclass, PDF points, origin bottom-left

contracts.name: SheetPlan
contracts.signature: SheetPlan(sheets: list[Sheet], paper_pt: tuple[float, float], warnings: list[LayoutWarning])

contracts.name: Sheet
contracts.signature: Sheet(index: int, front: OutputPage | None, back: OutputPage | None)

contracts.name: OutputPage
contracts.signature: OutputPage(source_ref: SourceRef | None, placement: Placement, is_filler: bool)

contracts.name: SourcePage
contracts.signature: SourcePage(ref: SourceRef, rotate_deg: int, skipped: bool)

contracts.name: LayoutSettings
contracts.signature: LayoutSettings(paper, gutter_pt, binding_edge: Literal['left','right'], scale_mode='fit_height', start_on_recto, landscape_policy) - 'top' binding deferred to v2

contracts.name: LayoutWarning
contracts.signature: LayoutWarning(sheet_index: int, kind: Literal['clipped_by_page','clipped_by_imageable_area','mixed_orientation','mixed_dpi'], detail: str)

contracts.name: load_pdf
contracts.signature: load_pdf(path: str) -> list[SourcePage] — metadata-only, raises EncryptedPdfError

contracts.name: load_image_dir
contracts.signature: load_image_dir(path: str) -> list[SourcePage] — natsorted, EXIF-corrected, img2pdf-normalized

contracts.name: LayoutStrategy
contracts.signature: def impose(self, pages: Sequence[SourcePage], settings: LayoutSettings) -> SheetPlan — v2 seam for signature/saddle-stitch strategies

contracts.name: GutterShiftStrategy
contracts.signature: implements LayoutStrategy; scale_mode 'fit_height' (default) or 'fixed_gutter'

contracts.name: export
contracts.signature: export(plan: SheetPlan, out_path: str, sheets: Sequence[int] | None = None) -> None — pikepdf as_form_xobject + calc_form_xobject_placement

contracts.name: RenderedPage
contracts.signature: RenderedPage(width: int, height: int, rgba: bytes) — raw buffer, no Qt or PIL type crosses the core boundary

contracts.name: render_sheet
contracts.signature: render_sheet(plan, sheet_index, side, dpi, cancel=None) -> RenderedPage - MUST rasterize the exported PDF via export_sheet_cached; never composites from Placement independently

contracts.name: thumbnails
contracts.signature: thumbnails(pages: Sequence[SourcePage], start: int, count: int, dpi: int = 36) -> list[RenderedPage] — range-based by contract; no whole-document variant exists

contracts.name: ink_bbox
contracts.signature: ink_bbox(ref: SourceRef, dpi: int = 36) -> tuple[float, float, float, float] — cached per ref

contracts.name: PrintBackend
contracts.signature: def submit(self, plan: SheetPlan, sheets: Sequence[int], printer_name: str, copies: int, dpi: int) -> PrintResult

contracts.name: PrintResult
contracts.signature: PrintResult(submitted: int, job_id: str | None, error: str | None)

contracts.name: plan_passes
contracts.signature: plan_passes(plan: SheetPlan, profile: PrinterProfile, sheets: Sequence[int] | None = None) -> list[PrintPass]

contracts.name: PrintPass
contracts.signature: PrintPass(index: int, sheet_order: list[int], side: Literal['front','back'], reload_instruction: str, rotate_backs: bool) - reload_instruction displayed verbatim by SS-12; rotate_backs applied by SS-08

contracts.name: PrinterProfile
contracts.signature: PrinterProfile(version, flip_axis, output_face, feed_edge, reverse_stack, imageable_area_pt, calibrated_at, calibration_version) + save/load + built-in presets

contracts.name: save_project
contracts.signature: save_project(project, path) -> None — JSON, references only, top-level version: 1

contracts.name: load_project
contracts.signature: load_project(path) -> Project — raises/returns SourceChangedWarning on sha256 mismatch

contracts.name: log_print_job
contracts.signature: log_print_job(printer: str, profile: PrinterProfile, sheets: Sequence[int], dpi: int, pass_index: int) -> None — required by Intent constraints

contracts.name: QtPrintBackend
contracts.signature: implements PrintBackend; setFullPage(True), margins from PrinterProfile.imageable_area_pt, chunked submission (default 10)

contracts.name: AppState
contracts.signature: AppState.project, mutate(fn) -> None (snapshots first), undo(), redo() — all project mutation flows through mutate; bounded snapshot depth 50

contracts.name: MainWindow
contracts.signature: hosts every view, owns the single AppState; SS-14 asserts every deckle/app/views module is imported here

contracts.name: PrintSession
contracts.signature: PrintSession(plan, profile, backend, sheets=None, test_first=False) with start(), advance(), confirm_test_sheet(), resume(sheets_completed) [per-pass], list_resumable(), state - backend injected, Qt-free

contracts.name: derive_profile
contracts.signature: derive_profile(answers: Mapping[str, str]) -> PrinterProfile — pure, total over the enumerated answer space

contracts.name: build_test_plan
contracts.signature: build_test_plan() -> SheetPlan — synthetic 4-sheet plan with asymmetric corner glyphs, flows through the ordinary print path

contracts.name: Project
contracts.signature: Project(pages: list[SourcePage], layout: LayoutSettings, printer: str | None) - the document model (added by red-team C-1)

contracts.name: export_sheet_cached
contracts.signature: export_sheet_cached(plan: SheetPlan, sheet_index: int) -> str - single-sheet PDF path, bounded LRU cache keyed by (sheet_index, plan_hash), cleared on project close (red-team P-4)
